items.reviewBody: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Death Wish Coffee Dark Roast Ground has quickly become a staple in my morning routine! ☺️☕️First of all, the packaging is sleek, sturdy, and keeps the coffee super fresh. The grind consistency is spot on, making the brewing process effortless whether I'm using a drip coffee maker or a French press. It brews into a rich, full-body cup with incredible depth and no bitter aftertaste. The finish is smooth with dark chocolate and subtle cherry notes. leaving a pleasant taste that lasts. If you're looking for a strong, flavorful coffee that delivers an amazing caffeine kick without sacrificing quality, this is absolutely it!❤️☕️☕️☕️
